dct_description_sm: This project was developed with the following objectives: (1) to continue sea ice monitoring in Clyde River; (2) to offer sea ice safety and self-rescue training led by local sea ice experts, using Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit and new technology; and (3) to train another community to monitor sea ice, sharing experience and skills obtained by the Ittaq Heritage and Research Centre through the development and implementation of the Clyde River Climate Change Adaptation Action Plan.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Training, Monitoring, and Sharing Sea Ice Expertise: Implementing the Clyde River Climate Change Adaptation Action Plan
